subject: feat: implement the full roadmap — provider matrix, observability, governance, workflows, and scale (#19)
branch triage: retire all 8 stale local codex/* branches
decision: Delete all 8 local codex/* branches without opening PRs; GitHub main (87ff2c0, v2.4.1) already contains every salvageable change.
why: Measured each branch with two-dot diff against github/main tip rather than three-dot (which compares against the merge-base and misleadingly renders main's newer work as branch additions). Every branch is strictly behind main: codex/secrets-sync-fabric-boundary is 0 ahead/14 behind (fully merged); preserve-local-main-release-work, cd-rerun-idempotent, ci-cache-polish and final-alignment are patch-identical upstream per git cherry '-' and shipped as merged PRs #14/#11/#10; cd-publish-fix and stabilization-wip show git cherry '+' only because they were squash-merged (PRs #12 and #8) so SHAs cannot match — their content is superseded, e.g. main's tools/check_python_dist.py is 108 lines including tag validation from PR #15 versus the branch's 76, and main already completed the cmd/secretsync to cmd/secrets-sync rename that the branch would revert; go-1.26.5-runtime-fix differs from main tip in only .release-please-manifest.json and CHANGELOG.md, where main is ahead by the release-please 2.4.1 commit. Merging any branch would regress main, so no PR is warranted.
